text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ dominates the race with a

stunning performance and finishes ahead
of
Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Genuinely recognizing her strength,
Narita
Taishin puts Бива Хаяхидэ in
even greater
spirits.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит is envious of the fun race
that
Нарита Таисин and Бива Хаяхидэ
shared...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But the Twinkle Series is not over yet,
and they'll
have as many chances as they
want to race
together again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The BNW trio promises to once again
face off at
the autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
